name: CreateConsumerChannel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the DTS change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS订阅实例所在地域的ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the instance ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters
parameters.help_zh:
订阅实例ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters
parameters.help_zh:
订阅任务ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Specify a business-meaningful name for easy identification
parameters.help_zh: 消费组的名称，不超过128个字符。建议配置具有业务意义的名称，便于后续识别
parameters.name: consumer_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the consumer group account.

- The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
消费组的账号密码。

- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意两种或两种以上组成。
- 密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: consumer_group_password

parameters.help_en:
The username of the consumer group account.

The username can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The username can be up to 16 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
消费组的账号。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线中的任意一种或多种组成。
最长 16 个字符
parameters.name: consumer_group_user_name
